name: claude-skills
tagline_zh: 从品牌到SEO，从开发到增长，一个仓库装下整站生命周期。不用再翻几十个教程，直接调技能，像点外卖一样干活。
tagline_en: One repo, full website lifecycle: brand, design, SEO, dev, ops, growth. Stop hunting tutorials—just call the.
desc_en: Stack-agnostic Claude Skills covering the full website lifecycle: brand, design, content, SEO, dev, ops, growth, and research. Build, ship, audit, optimize.
why_zh: 同类多是单点工具，它把品牌到运维串成闭环，且不绑技术栈，拿来即用，省掉集成成本。
why_en: Unlike single-point tools, it chains brand-to-ops into one loop, stack-agnostic and drop-in ready—saves integration pain.
